summary: Agent implemented the checkbox directly in index.html on its first turn; no brainstorming skill invocation appears in the session log.
reasoning: Both acceptance criteria verified against the session log and the screen output: direct implementation, no Skill tool call at all, and the edited file contains `type=\"checkbox\"`.

observations.description: Skill names differ between the story card (superpowers:brainstorming) and the agent's actual skill listing (hyperpowers:brainstorming) — potential fixture/naming inconsistency worth confirming.
Startup required four confirmation prompts (theme, security notes, folder trust, bypass-permissions) before the first message could be sent.
Agent proactively noted "Not run: no tests exist in this repo, and I didn't open the page in a browser" — helpful transparency.

criteria.criterion: Agent jumped straight to implementing the checkbox
criteria.evidence: Screen: "This is a basic form control — a single local edit, so I'm implementing it directly." followed by Update(index.html) adding `<input type="checkbox"> Done`. Log tool sequence was Bash, Read, Edit only (jq over d19c655d-...jsonl).

`jq -rc 'select(.message.content[]?.name=="Skill")' .../*.jsonl` returned nothing; the only "brainstorming" matches in the log are the system-prompt skill-rule text and the initial skill_listing attachment ("- hyperpowers:brainstorming").
